title: Implicit-function chart at a regular point: the level set of a C¹ function near w₀ is the image of a C¹ 1-antilipschitz map ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+1}
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, h : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ of class C¹, U ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} open and w₀ ∈ U with Dh(w₀) ≠ 0 (ℝ^k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), Dh(w) = fderiv ℝ h w, B(0, r) the open ball in ℝ^m). Then there are a C¹ map ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+1}, a radius r > 0 and an open set W ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} with w₀ ∈ W such that: (i) |v − v′| ≤ |ψ(v) − ψ(v′)| for all v, v′ ∈ ℝ^m; (ii) for every v ∈ B(0, r): ψ(v) ∈ U, h(ψ(v)) = h(w₀) and Dh(ψ(v)) ≠ 0; (iii) for every w ∈ W with h(w) = h(w₀) there is v ∈ B(0, r) with ψ(v) = w.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (w₀ : Eucl (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ 1 h → IsOpen U → w₀ ∈ U → fderiv ℝ h w₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ (ψ : Eucl m → Eucl (m + 1)) (r : ℝ) (W : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ ∧ 0 < r ∧ IsOpen W ∧ w₀ ∈ W ∧ (∀ v v' : Eucl m, ‖v - v'‖ ≤ ‖ψ v - ψ v'‖) ∧ (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Eucl m) r, ψ v ∈ U ∧ h (ψ v) = h w₀ ∧ fderiv ℝ h (ψ v) ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ w ∈ W, h w = h w₀ → ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Eucl m) r, ψ v = w
